entities.name: God Trials
entities.description: A series of tasks on Amonkhet that each inhabitant aspired to complete, the core of the plane's faith, perverted by Nicol Bolas into a never-ending cycle.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane whose people's faith centers on the God Trials.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who intruded on Amonkhet and perverted the God Trials, promising an afterlife that was actually transformation into Eternals.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet whose population was held in a never-ending state of exercise and which was later desolated and abandoned.

entities.name: Cartouche
entities.description: A record of an initiate's achievements awarded after a trial, believed to preserve the initiate's essence for the afterlife.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God of the Trial of Zeal, who grants the initiates who pass four trials a Glorified Death with her forked staff.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of the Trial of Solidarity, who tests initiates' ability to work together.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God of the Trial of Knowledge, who tests mental capacity in a labyrinth of water and illusion.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God of the Trial of Strength, who has little patience for the weak.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of the Trial of Ambition, who tests willingness to do what must be done.

entities.name: Trial of Solidarity
entities.description: Oketra's trial, the first, testing the ability to work with others by defending an obelisk.

entities.name: Trial of Knowledge
entities.description: Kefnet's trial testing mental capacity in a labyrinth of water and illusion.

entities.name: Trial of Strength
entities.description: Rhonas's trial testing physical capacity in a jungle.

entities.name: Trial of Ambition
entities.description: Bontu's trial in which initiates compete and sacrifice each other.

entities.name: Trial of Zeal
entities.description: Hazoret's final trial, fought in the Proving Ground and ending in Glorified Death.

entities.name: Eternal
entities.description: What the worthy dead were transformed into, revealed to be the true nature of the afterlife.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The event preceding which the last Trial was held, and after which the trials could not continue.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas takes over the God Trials, holding the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.
events.quote: Bolas took this tenet and perverted it to hold the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.

events.summary: Oketra's Trial of Solidarity: a crop must defend its obelisk and retrieve her arrow together.
events.quote: The crop had to work together to defend their obelisk and retrieve Oketra's arrow.

events.summary: Kefnet's Trial of Knowledge: initiates must solve a maze of illusion by recognizing the glyph spell that reveals the true exit.
events.quote: A vast labyrinth of water and illusion extended before them.

events.summary: Rhonas's Trial of Strength: initiates climb thorny vines, lose spellcasting to a toxin and must claim a basilisk's scale for the cure.
events.quote: Initiates had to climb thorny vines and ride down a raging waterfall.

events.summary: Bontu's Trial of Ambition: crop members are made to compete and sacrifice each other.
events.quote: where they were made to compete rather than cooperate.

events.summary: Hazoret's Trial of Zeal ends with the surviving initiate receiving the most Glorified Death from her forked staff.
events.quote: Hazoret granted that initiate the most Glorified Death with her forked staff.

events.summary: The afterlife promised to the worthy dead is revealed to be transformation into Eternals.
events.quote: This "afterlife" was revealed to be the transformation into an Eternal .

events.summary: With most gods and citizens dead and Naktamun abandoned, the trials can no longer continue.

relations.quote: Oketra's was the first trial initiates undertook.

relations.note: The final trial took place in her monument.
relations.quote: Hazoret saw the initiates who passed the first four trials as her children.

relations.note: Perverted the trials, which predated his intrusion.
relations.quote: Originally, the Trials predated Nicol Bolas's intrusion into the plane
